Heya Soulslingers!

It’s official — [b]Soulslinger: Envoy of Death[/b] has left Early Access and launched into version 1.0! After four years of development, your journey through the afterlife reaches its most intense and personal chapter yet. And trust us, this update is massive!

[h3][b]💀 New Realm: Trauma[/b][/h3]
Step into Trauma, the darkest and most dangerous realm yet. Twisted memories, shattered souls, and haunting fragments of the past swirl together in this new endgame zone. It’s a brutal, atmospheric gauntlet designed to test everything you’ve learned so far. Only the strongest Soulslingers will survive.

[h3][b]🧨 Face the Final Villain: Victor[/b][/h3]
At the heart of Trauma, you’ll face Victor — the elusive and powerful mastermind behind the soul-corrupting horrors you've been fighting all along. This is the ultimate showdown, and it introduces brand-new, never-before-seen mechanics that will challenge even the most seasoned players. Victor isn’t just another boss — he’s the boss.

[h3][b]🚨 Launch Sale — 50% OFF![/b][/h3]
To celebrate the full release, Soulslinger: Envoy of Death is 50% off for the first 14 days!

🗓️ Starts: Thu, Apr 17
🗓️ Ends: Thu, May 1
💸 Launch Price: 8.99€ (down from 17.99€)

Version 1.0 includes plenty of quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes, visual polish, and additional lore to uncover. Here's the full changelog:

notes.title: 🔥 Soulslinger Full Launch is planned for April 17!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/80d506552f539198210610b949078ec728bfd037.jpg[/img]

Heya Soulslingers!

The wait is over! [b]Soulslinger: Envoy of Death[/b] is leaving Early Access and stepping into its [b]full release with Update 1.0 on April 17[/b]! This update is packed with new content and the long-awaited conclusion to Soulslinger’s journey. Let's dive right in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/98ead5d553c6fba0bb2db85583c2201c6d8c6a73.png[/img]

[h3][b]Enter Trauma[/b][/h3]

Brace yourself for the Trauma realm! Within its depths, you’ll face four new, incredibly challenging enemies, each embodying one of the first four stages of grief: Denial, Anger, Bargain and Depression. All four are much more powerful than any enemy you’ve faced before. For instance, Anger is an explosive powerhouse with devastating area-of-effect attacks that can wipe out the unprepared whereas Depression is unlike any enemy before, as it doesn’t attack. Instead, it slows you to a crawl with its oppressive aura, making escape almost impossible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/6426a71539decfa5eef855eb70f4a6b6cb41f805.png[/img]
Survive these manifestations of grief, and you'll earn the right to face the ultimate adversary...


[h3][b]Victor Awaits[/b][/h3]

At the end of the Trauma realm, the battle you've been waiting for finally arrives. Victor, the enigmatic mastermind pulling the strings, is now a full-fledged boss fight, featuring never-before-seen mechanics that will test your skill, strategy, and determination. This is the final confrontation – do you have what it takes to take him down?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/061f716024eb12af0c09496872e4f16b9290c6df.png[/img]

[h3][b]Introducing Craftable Tomes[/b][/h3]

A brand-new crafting category is here! Tomes unlock new perks and ultimate abilities for each Essence, breathing new life into your combat strategies.

[list][*] [b]Tome of Fire[/b] – Unleash devastating fire-based abilities that make it much easier to set enemies on fire, as well as the Firestorm ultimate ability.
[*] [b]Tome of Lightning[/b] – Harness the storm to stun enemies much longer, and also unlock the Tempest’s Wrath ultimate ability.
[*] [b]Tome of Blood[/b] – Turns the Blood Essence into a powerful tool for survival, making health regeneration more viable than ever.
[*] [b]Tome of Poison[/b] – Inflict slow, painful damage with enhanced toxin-based attacks, and unlock the Plague’s Embrace ultimate ability.[/list]
In addition to the new perks, you can also combine the new utlimate abilities with the Bloodshed ultimate ability, creating some of the most powerful abilities in the entire game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/faac72d3b937417fa43c0c659a97d61e1f57d90a.png[/img]

[h3][b]Trail of Ghosts Mode[/b][/h3]

Looking for the ultimate test of endurance? The new Trail of Ghosts mode is an endless survival challenge where waves of enemies grow stronger with each round. The deeper you go, the greater the rewards – but beware, Victor's Army won’t be your only concern. Expect bosses and elite enemies to show up in overwhelming numbers, making every second a fight for survival. How long can you last?


[h3][b]A Fitting End[/b][/h3]

The stories of Death, Helene, Lady Valerie, Victor, and of course, Soulslinger himself are finally coming to a close. New conversations in Haven wrap up their arcs, bringing surprise twists and an emotional conclusion to your journey through the afterlife. If you've been invested in their fates, now’s the time to see how it all ends.


[h3][b]Soulslinger 1.0 – The Journey Comes Full Circle[/b][/h3]

This is it, Soulslingers – the full release of the game you've helped shape with your feedback and support. From new enemies and realms to groundbreaking new game mechanics, Update 1.0 is our love letter to you, the players. Thank you for being part of this journey with us. 

--Ede out

Heya Soulslingers!

We’re excited to announce that the next update for Soulslinger: Envoy of Death is just around the corner, and this time, it’s all about YOU, the players! Based on your feedback, we will be making several impactful changes and additions to enhance your experience. Here’s what’s new:

Heya Soulslingers!

In just a few days, [b]Soulslinger: Envoy of Death[/b] will receive its largest update yet, and we can't wait for you to dive in! The second half of the Outskirts realm will finally arrive, packed with treacherous new arenas, a host of never-before-seen enemies, and surprise encounters that break up regular gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/9247597468ec28a3250e709059fb2f5c11b2a855.jpg[/img]

We’re also introducing a brand-new weapon — the Wraithshot. A powerful addition to your arsenal, the Wraithshot schematics can be found after defeating the Revenant Sheriff boss. This gun is devastatingly strong, but its strength is balanced by the fact that it needs to be reloaded after each shot. But if that shot is used well, it can tear through the entire battlefield!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/3245383520ff8b3b6a2f00433ccbb0f9d2f0a8d9.jpg[/img]

But that’s not all. We’re thrilled to finally introduce the game's main villain, Victor. With him comes a brand-new challenge: Rush Encounters. We have just released our first major update, The Forgotten Graveyard Update. In this patch, we are introducing a completely new realm, a new boss, a new weapon, new enemies to defeat and much more. We also made some balancing changes and fixed some bugs.  

[b]Forgotten Graveyard[/b]

Welcome to the Forgotten Graveyard! Are you ready to face the challenges that await you in a realm controlled by The Countess? Be prepared to fight ferocious monsters that you have never faced before to reach her. 

But if you manage to defeat her, you will be rewarded with her precious weapon, the Night Quartet. It operates differently from the other weapons you were able to use before, as it has a cooldown mechanism. This means that you can fire it as many times as you want without having to reload it, but be cautious about overheating it! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/dbdddcda0615e8e3f2cdc42d0fc81848650ff158.png[/img]
[b]Blood Essence and Spectral Essence[/b]

Blood Essence is used for a set of powerful new abilities focused on absorbing the blood and spirits of your opponents to heal yourself, deal more damage, or enhance your ultimate skill. However, some of these abilities are consumed upon use. Utilizing the Blood Essence abilities can give you an edge in challenging battles and help you in seemingly impossible fights. 

To obtain Spectral Essence skills, you must venture into the treacherous 'Forgotten Graveyard'. These abilities are unique and powerful, for example, you can unlock explosive homing projectiles that can hunt down your targets and deal massive damage, or trade in your dash for a double jump. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/X7F9bk8r/New-Abilities-Gif.gif[/img]

[b]Power Totem[/b]

The Power Totem is another new addition to Limbo. You can now spend the tears you've collected on permanent upgrades that will help you in your fight against the Cartel. You can upgrade as much as you want to get even stronger, as there is no end to the Power Totem—however, the cost  increases each time. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/qRwB9TpG/Powertotem.gif[/img]

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/dc3e9fc7a88f7aa6f8280e1e175e82eb789180bc.jpg[/img]

Howdy fellow gunslingers!

With this third and last "[b]The Loops of Limbo[/b]" update before the Early Access release of Soulslinger, I will tell you a bit about how you equip and upgrade yourself for and during the fight against the cartel.

As explained in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2429240/view/3906371681132975670]last update[/url], Soulslinger is a roguelite FPS. In essence, the gameplay can be described as follows: fight, die, upgrade, repeat. It's a run-based shooter in which you will die often, but every run brings progress. However, we must distinguish between temporary and permanent progress. So, lets hop into a little more detail!

Soulslinger's combat system is not only based on western-inspired firearms with a unique afterlife touch, but also on powers. There are a number of essences between which you can choose, and these essences mostly offer active abilities as well as passive skills. For example, there is the "Fire Essence", "Electric Essence", "Toxic Essence" and the "Shadow Essence". For the Early Access release there will be these 4 distinct essence classes in the game. Additional further essences will follow up until the full release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/c98f5bc890ec8be23764eb053394029f34c5816f.jpg[/img]
[i]The yellow icons are active abilities, the gray one is a passive skill[/i]

Before you enter an arena through a portal, you can see what reward awaits you if you survive the battle. This can be one of the various essences, but also other useful resources, bonus levels, secret arenas, etc. You don't have to commit to one of the essences, you can also mix the essences for your skills and abilities. The focus on one essence, but also a strategic mix of essences can give you advantages.

If you focus on the "Toxic Essence", for example, you can load your weapon with poisoned bullets that damage enemies, poison them and also poison nearby enemies with a wave. This active ability paired with passive skills such as increased poison damage to enemies or enemies infecting each other with poisoning can be very effective.

But you can also use the poisoned bullets in combination with a "Shadow Essence" ability: for a few seconds you can call two ghostly Soulslinger silhouettes by your side, that fire at random enemies and use the same poisoned bullets that you use. In this way, the damage of the toxically charged projectiles can be tripled. And of course it also plays a role whether you use a shotgun with only two shots or a revolver with six shots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/b523bd2f5b791a6623741adfed82577fc4d249e9.jpg[/img][i]The setup mixes the poisoned bullets ("Toxic Essence") with two ghostly Soulslinger silhouettes ("Shadow Essence")[/i]

When dying you lose all collected essences and essence upgrades, because those are temporary. All resources collected, which you can use to unlock and upgrade relics and weapons at the workshop, are kept after the end of each run. This allows you to prepare for your next run in the hub world Haven and try out new combinations of weapons and the various essences on your next run.

As said, this issue of "[b]The Loops of Limbo[/b]" is the last one before the Early Access release next week. But there are two more characters that I will introduce to you in "Wanted Dead or Alive" updates - stay tuned!

As the tension rises with each passing day, I really can't wait for you all to finally play [b]Soulslinger: Envoy of Death[/b].

You don't need to explain how a first person shooter works, do you? Run, aim, shoot, stay alive. As easy as it gets. And that's where the "roguelite" apsect comes into play. And exactly where "easy" ends.

Soulslinger is a run-based game in which you will die often. Very often. Because that's exactly what the game is designed around. Though dying ends your current run and causes you to lose most of your temporary buffs, there is also the "meta-progression". You collect resources that stick with you even when you die and you can spend them on permanent upgrades that make you stronger in the long run.

Our core design philosophy with [b]Soulslinger: Envoy of Death[/b] is to respect the player's time as much as possible. This is why even a 5 or 10 minute run can yield significant progress, you can work towards getting that next upgrade or crafting that new equipment that you wanted.

It would've been set in a mysterious cave on an alien planet and you would've descended deeper and deeper into the cave until finally you've uncovered all its secrets. Happy Friday, fellow gunslingers! 🤠

First things first: Thank you all so much for playing the [b]Soulslinger: Envoy of Death[/b] demo, and for providing some very valuable feedback on all channels! We are listening, reading, and collecting it everywhere: at gamescom, in the comments, the Steam Community Hub, the survey, on Discord, etc.

[h2][b]You all are fire![/b] 🔥[/h2]

Because this is exactly the feedback that is super important for us to prepare the game for release this year. We have created a to-do-list with a bunch of changes, fixes and optimizations, including the following:

[list][*] Expect [b]updated enemy AI[/b]: enemies will have additional behaviors and will be able to react to more situations in a natural way! (Eg. the archer enemy will perform a melee attack when you get close instead of running away, or the basic swarmer enemy will be able to dash closer to you)
[*] [b]Fast reload[/b]: during reload, you'll be able to press the "Fire" button at the right time to instantly complete the reload! If you time this right, you'll be able to cut the reload time in half, or less!
[*] Update to how Soulslinger handles: his [b]movements will feel more dynamic[/b] and will react to your input faster!
[*] [b]Smoother animations[/b]: enemy animations will appear to be smoother (i.e. no more choppy animations!)
[*] We're [b]revising enemy compositions[/b], discarding the ones that were boring to play against and amping up the ones we felt were a good fit!
[*] We're also in the process of [b]rebalancing enemy health and ability powers[/b], once again to make sure it all feels better to play![/list]
We will update the demo, and of course keep you up to date here on the Steam page. As these are some significant changes, please bear with us, this might take some time.
